title: DMT: The Jester Who Knew My Name

scenes.text: I don't know how to explain this without sounding like I lost a custody battle with reality, but DMT introduced me to a jester who knew everything about me.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator reluctantly introduces a DMT encounter with an all-knowing jester
scenes.query: same fully clothed red-and-teal theatrical jester from the television throne faces one adult male narrator seen only from behind inside a vivid DMT carnival palace, no narrator face, luminous geometry and moving television light
scenes.image_prompt: The same fully clothed red-and-teal theatrical jester established in scene 5 sits on the television throne inside a vivid DMT carnival palace. One adult male narrator stands several feet in front of the throne, shown only from behind with no visible face. Their two-person encounter is unmistakable; luminous sacred geometry and television reflections move through the room.
scenes.revision_note: Maybe an animated still frame of a Jester (DMT Style) and a man standing in front of him or her. I would probable use the person in frame 5 (slide 5) as the Jester. Because that person seemingly have more scenes in the slide.

scenes.text: One second, I was sitting in my room. The next, the walls folded inward like reality had received an eviction notice.
scenes.semantic_anchor: an ordinary room physically folds inward and ejects the narrator from reality
scenes.query: empty bedroom walls mystically fold inward like luminous origami while furniture bends toward a prismatic center, vivid cyan magenta emerald DMT geometry, continuous environmental motion, no people or faces
scenes.revision_note: Not Bad but since this is a DMT video I would try to make the scenery look like the rest of the video. Maybe mystical folding walls.

scenes.text: Colors I had never seen started pouring through the ceiling, and I was launched down a tunnel made of spinning faces, blinking eyes, and what looked suspiciously like God's screensaver.
scenes.semantic_anchor: impossible color pours into a tunnel of faces and eyes
scenes.query: hyper-saturated liquid color pours through a ceiling and becomes a fast moving kaleidoscopic tunnel of rotating theatrical faces and blinking eye patterns, playful vivid DMT motion graphics, deep black contrast, continuous forward travel

scenes.text: Then I landed in this enormous carnival palace. The floor was breathing. The pillars were laughing. Even the furniture seemed sarcastic.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator arrives inside a living sarcastic carnival palace
scenes.query: camera glides through a colorful carnival funhouse interior with moving checkerboard floor, spinning pillars, swaying chairs and vivid practical lights, genuine environmental motion, no text or diagrams

scenes.text: And sitting in the middle of it all was this jester on a throne made of televisions.
scenes.semantic_anchor: a recurring red-and-teal jester rules from a throne built from televisions
scenes.query: fully clothed theatrical jester in red and teal costume sits in an ornate carnival chair surrounded by flickering vintage television screens, expressive face, genuine body and screen motion, no nudity

scenes.text: Every screen was showing a different moment from my life. Not the important moments, obviously. No.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the television throne selects trivial embarrassing memories instead of milestones
scenes.query: wall of vintage television screens rapidly switches among mundane embarrassing home moments while major milestone footage is ignored, playful carnival colors, authentic moving video on every screen, no readable text

scenes.text: They were showing me checking my bank account three times, as if the number might feel guilty and increase.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator repeatedly refreshes an unchanged bank balance
scenes.query: tight close-up of the same adult narrator hand refreshing a mobile banking balance exactly three times on a phone, no face or body visible, no private information, vivid prismatic reflections, genuine finger and screen motion
scenes.revision_note: I wouldn't show a face on this. We are talking about one person who is narrating the story so many different faces looses the idea of identifying with the narrator. To the viewer if may become another fluff slide. I would look for a slide of a hand checking their banking account. No face in the slide. Like scene 8 which would complement this slide.

scenes.text: They showed me typing "No worries" while clearly having several worries.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator sends a calm message while visibly panicking
scenes.query: the short message No worries appears on a phone while several alarm icons, vibrating notifications and tangled charging cords multiply around it, bright realistic tabletop, comedic continuous object motion, phone content limited to those exact words

scenes.text: They showed me winning arguments in the shower six hours after the conversation ended. Apparently, the universe keeps excellent records.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator performs a victorious late argument alone in the shower while the universe records it
scenes.query: first-person view of the same adult narrator hand making triumphant argument gestures toward steamy shower glass six hours later, running water and cosmic record lights moving, no face, no exposed body, no nudity
scenes.revision_note: again, different faces, especially when there are only seemingly two entities in the whole video conversation.

scenes.text: The jester looked directly at me and said my full name.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the recurring jester recognizes the narrator personally
scenes.query: same fully clothed red-and-teal jester from scene 5 sits on a throne of flickering televisions, turns directly toward the unseen narrator and points knowingly, vivid DMT palace, no additional faces
scenes.image_prompt: The same fully clothed red-and-teal theatrical jester established in scene 5 sits on the identical television throne. The jester turns directly toward the unseen narrator and points knowingly while the screens flicker with prismatic light. Preserve the scene-5 costume, silhouette, throne, and carnival-palace identity; show no other face.
scenes.revision_note: Tv would be fine if it was the person from scene 5 sitting on it. Maybe an enhanced still clip (with motion effects) of a Jester.

scenes.text: First, middle, and last. He even emphasized my middle name the way my mother does when I've disappointed the entire bloodline.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the jester recites every part of the name with a mother's disappointed emphasis
scenes.query: older mother in a warm lived-in home leans toward camera and slowly wags one finger with a deeply disappointed full-name expression, framed family photographs behind her, genuine hand and facial motion, no text
scenes.revision_note: Maybe some depiction of an older woman wagging her finger at the viewer, as to be upset and calling out the person's entire name.

scenes.text: Then he smiled and said, "Welcome, great seeker of truth."
scenes.semantic_anchor: the jester sarcastically welcomes the narrator as a grand truth seeker
scenes.query: abstract luminous red-and-teal jester mask made entirely of mystical light smiles and gives a grand sarcastic welcome, bells and sacred geometry ripple outward, vivid DMT motion graphics, no realistic human face
scenes.revision_note: same, to many different faces. maybe some abstract mystical light face doing something. Perferably, jester looking.

scenes.text: I said, "You know who I am?" He laughed so hard that every television changed channels.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the jester's laughter physically changes every television channel
scenes.query: wall of vintage televisions rapidly changes channels while a fully clothed laughing theatrical performer gestures in front, vivid carnival lights, genuine screen and body motion, no nudity or readable text

scenes.text: "Oh, we all know who you are," he said. "You announce it constantly."
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator constantly broadcasts a performed identity
scenes.query: rotating theatrical masks pass in front of microphones and megaphones under bright stage lights, each mask moving into the spotlight, genuine object and camera motion, no text or diagrams

scenes.text: Then the screens started showing every time I had tried to appear calm, mysterious, evolved, or spiritually advanced.
scenes.semantic_anchor: televisions replay the narrator's attempts to perform spiritual sophistication
scenes.query: multiple television screens show an empty meditation cushion being repeatedly repositioned for a ring light while incense, crystals and a camera arrange themselves into an increasingly performative spiritual display, bright studio, comedic genuine object motion

scenes.text: One screen showed me telling someone, "I trust the universe." The next showed me panicking because a package was two days late.
scenes.semantic_anchor: professed cosmic trust collapses over a late package
scenes.query: vast vivid universe of moving galaxies and stars expands peacefully while one tiny delayed package drifts through orbit, comic contrast between cosmic trust and petty panic, no people, faces, labels or diagrams
scenes.revision_note: I would use some type of universe slide.

scenes.text: The jester leaned forward. "Such faith," he said. "Truly inspirational."
scenes.semantic_anchor: the jester delivers a deeply sarcastic compliment
scenes.query: tight close-up of the same adult narrator hand holding a small cross necklace while prismatic universe light moves behind it, no face or body visible, consistent hand appearance, genuine finger and pendant motion
scenes.revision_note: another different face. I would probably show a hand holding a necklace with a cross. Be careful not to show different color hands. We want to make it seem as though the same person is in all the slides.

scenes.text: I asked him why I was there. He said, "You asked to see the truth."
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator's request for truth is presented back as the reason for the encounter
scenes.query: small brass bell rolls across a carnival floor toward a bright mirror lined path while colored television light travels along the route, continuous camera movement, no text or diagrams

scenes.text: I looked around at the carnival, the floating masks, and the furniture mocking me. I said, "I thought truth would look more sacred."
scenes.semantic_anchor: the absurd carnival violates the narrator's expectation that truth must look sacred
scenes.query: camera surveys a vivid living carnival palace where fully covering theatrical masks float, chairs turn away and lamps tilt sarcastically, contrasted with a distant pristine sacred arch, continuous object motion, no visible body

scenes.text: He gasped. "Oh, I'm sorry. Did you purchase the premium enlightenment package? This is the basic plan. We show you your personality."
scenes.semantic_anchor: enlightenment is treated as a sarcastic service plan that exposes personality
scenes.query: rear view of one adult narrator seated in meditation with face completely hidden while vivid mystical ribbons and sacred geometry swirl around the body, DMT palace colors, genuine environmental motion
scenes.revision_note: Maybe an enhanced still slide of a person in a meditating position turn away from us with mystical lights swirling around.

scenes.text: Then every screen became a mirror.
scenes.semantic_anchor: all television screens physically transform into mirrors
scenes.query: dozens of moving vintage television screens simultaneously liquefy and transform into clear mirrors reflecting the same viewer from different angles, vivid cyan magenta carnival light, continuous literal transformation

scenes.text: I saw every identity I had ever defended. The intelligent one. The wounded one. The misunderstood one.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the mirrors reveal several defended identities as separate roles
scenes.query: three complete theatrical masks rotate inside connected mirrors, one with spectacles, one cracked protective mask and one hooded mask, each loosens and turns away, bright cinematic object motion, no text or diagrams

scenes.text: The one who was definitely over it, but still checking their profile for completely scientific reasons.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator secretly checks a profile while pretending to have moved on
scenes.query: close-up of a hand repeatedly opening the same social media profile on a smartphone, scrolling briefly, closing the app and immediately reopening it, bright realistic room, continuous finger and screen motion, no readable personal data

scenes.text: And every time I tried to explain myself, the jester rang a tiny bell. Ding.
scenes.semantic_anchor: every attempted self-explanation is interrupted by one tiny bell
scenes.query: tight close-up of the same adult narrator hand repeatedly tapping a polished hotel service desk bell on a colorful counter, no face or body, each press clearly compresses and releases the bell, genuine motion
scenes.revision_note: I would find one of the bells that sit on the counter that you ring when the hotel attendant is not at her desk. I would look for a hand that just keeps tapping the bell. If not still image.

scenes.text: Ding. Excuse. Ding. Excuse wearing spiritual vocabulary. Ding. Trauma with a LinkedIn profile.
scenes.semantic_anchor: three bell rings expose increasingly polished forms of excuse
scenes.query: same polished hotel service desk bell and same adult narrator hand in matching close-up, three distinct rapid taps in rhythm, prismatic reflections, no face, body, text or temple bells, genuine mechanical motion
scenes.revision_note: another slide or picture like slide 24

scenes.text: I finally shouted, "Can you stop making everything into a joke?" For the first time, he became completely still.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator demands seriousness and the jester abruptly freezes
scenes.query: same fully clothed red-and-teal mystical jester from scene 5 laughs inside the television-throne palace, then becomes completely still as one brass bell settles, no additional character faces
scenes.image_prompt: The same fully clothed red-and-teal theatrical jester established in scene 5 laughs on the television throne inside the vivid DMT carnival palace, then holds perfectly still as a small brass bell settles. Preserve the scene-5 costume, silhouette, throne, and red-teal identity. No narrator face and no extra characters.
scenes.revision_note: I would look for a mystical laughing Jester. Or a still jester.

scenes.text: Then he said, "You keep asking for truth, but you flinch every time it looks funny."
scenes.semantic_anchor: the jester identifies the narrator's fear of truth when it arrives through comedy
scenes.query: same jester calmly holds up a clear mirror that reflects the viewer flinching from a smiling truth, carnival background becomes quiet and sharply focused, subtle prismatic movement, serious expressive performance

scenes.text: That hit me harder than anything else. Because beneath every joke, something was disappearing.
scenes.semantic_anchor: each joke removes a layer of defended identity
scenes.query: layers of ornate theatrical masks peel from an invisible face and dissolve into vivid moving particles one by one, each comic ripple reveals a clearer center beneath, elegant DMT motion graphics, no body or nudity

scenes.text: Every time I laughed at one of my identities, it loosened.
scenes.semantic_anchor: laughter physically loosens each identity mask
scenes.query: extreme close-up of only the narrator mouth and lower face laughing with relief as colored identity-mask reflections loosen and drift away, no eyes and no full face, skin tone consistent with narrator hands, genuine motion
scenes.revision_note: Maybe a slide of just a mouth laughing. Make sure it matches the person's color of the rest of the slides.

scenes.text: Every time I stopped defending myself, another television went dark.
scenes.semantic_anchor: releasing self-defense switches off one television at a time
scenes.query: a raised defensive shield slowly lowers while rows of vintage televisions switch off one at a time in a clear sequence, reflections fade across an unoccupied room, genuine practical screen and object motion

scenes.text: Eventually, only one screen remained. It showed the jester sitting on his throne.
scenes.semantic_anchor: one final television preserves the jester after every other identity screen goes dark
scenes.query: camera moves through a darkened wall of silent vintage televisions toward the only remaining glowing screen, which shows the same red-and-teal jester sitting alone on his throne, vivid focused motion

scenes.text: Then he removed his mask. And, of course, it was my face. Because apparently the universe had decided subtlety was no longer part of the budget.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the jester removes a mask and reveals the narrator's own face
scenes.query: same fully clothed red-and-teal jester from scene 5 slowly removes the familiar jester mask on the television throne, revealing the narrator beneath while palace screens flicker, exact costume continuity
scenes.image_prompt: The same fully clothed red-and-teal theatrical jester established in scene 5 sits on the identical television throne and slowly removes the familiar jester mask, revealing that the narrator was underneath. Preserve the scene-5 costume, silhouette, throne, and carnival-palace identity; make the transformation clear without introducing an unrelated character.
scenes.revision_note: I like the scene but the jester look changed. If would be perfect if it matched the person in slide 5.

scenes.text: He looked at me and said, "I've known every name you've ever called yourself. I was the one underneath them, laughing."
scenes.semantic_anchor: the laughing awareness beneath every temporary name identifies itself
scenes.query: same revealed narrator-jester identity from the scene-5 television throne smiles beneath layers of unlabeled masks that dissolve into prismatic light, no unrelated face or costume change
scenes.image_prompt: Continue the exact red-and-teal jester identity and television throne established in scene 5 and revealed in the previous scene. The same underlying narrator-jester smiles as unlabeled masks from past identities dissolve into prismatic light. Preserve costume, silhouette, setting, and face continuity; do not introduce another person.
scenes.revision_note: same as the comment in slide 32

scenes.text: Then the entire palace collapsed into a single point of light. I opened my eyes back in my room, laughing so hard I could barely breathe.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the carnival collapses into light and the narrator returns laughing to the original room
scenes.query: entire vivid carnival palace and every television collapse inward into one narrow brilliant band of prismatic light against deep black, mystical DMT transformation, no bedroom, people, faces, text or diagrams
scenes.revision_note: Mystical collapse of something into a single ban of light.

scenes.text: And that's when I understood what happened. The jester wasn't laughing because my life was meaningless.
scenes.semantic_anchor: the narrator rejects the idea that the jester's laughter made life meaningless
scenes.primary_symbol: narrator hands and softened television reflection
scenes.query: first-person view of the same narrator hands resting in the original warm bedroom while a softened red-and-teal jester reflection glows in a dark television, no visible face, curtains and light moving gently
scenes.revision_note: Make sure we are not showing different faces when there is a story line. Same color body parts with no face so it seems like it is the same person.

scenes.text: He was laughing because I had spent years treating every temporary version of myself like a sacred monument.
scenes.semantic_anchor: temporary identities have been treated like permanent sacred monuments
scenes.query: many faceless human shadows perform different temporary life roles across one wall, working, praying, arguing, celebrating and posing like monuments, moving window light makes every shadow dissolve, no faces
scenes.revision_note: I would do a slide with many different shadows doing different things. no faces.

scenes.text: Maybe truth doesn't always arrive as an ancient teacher surrounded by golden light.
scenes.semantic_anchor: truth need not resemble a solemn ancient teacher in golden light
scenes.query: an empty ceremonial seat sits inside soft golden light, then the solemn light moves aside to reveal a colorful brass jester bell rolling into frame, premium realistic cinematic motion, unoccupied scene, no silhouette

scenes.text: Sometimes it shows up wearing bells, sits on a throne made of your embarrassing memories, and roasts you until there is nobody left to impress.
scenes.semantic_anchor: truth arrives as the jester and jokes away the final need to impress anyone
scenes.query: small brass jester bell sits before a dark television throne made of embarrassing memory reflections while curtains and prismatic room light move gently, no people, faces, hands or bodies
